verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the webhooks list, which includes an "Application deleted" event. That implies applications can be deleted, but nothing documents user-facing retention controls or a deletion workflow. Missing for 10: configurable data retention policies, documented candidate/data deletion or purge controls (UI or API), privacy/GDPR erasure workflows, retention controls for AI artifacts (Notetaker recordings/transcripts, Voice AI interviews), independent corroboration.
